caption: The drawing depicts a single, elongated metallic object with a brownish hue, resembling a tool or weapon handle. The top portion of the object features a pronounced spiral design curving inward in a circular manner, situated prominently on the left. Extending horizontally from the spiral is a straight, narrow segment culminating in a small curl on the right side. The central shaft of the object is cylindrical and tapers slightly toward the bottom, which ends in a flat base. The overall coloring consists of gradients of brown, suggesting the appearance of metal or polished wood. There are two inset diagrams on the page; the upper left inset contains a faint, sketch-like detail focusing on a small rectangular feature on the horizontal section, while the lower right inset displays a simplified outline of a dagger or blade, indicating the potential use of the main object as a handle or hilt. All objects are drawn within a faint rectangular frame on a lightly yellowed background.
